compose:
# BigData Sandbox :full, generado desde la interfaz (localhost:8080)
#   docker compose up -d        crear y prender
#   docker compose logs -f      seguir el arranque hasta "Cluster LISTO"
#   docker compose stop         apagar en orden (los datos quedan)

name: bigdata

services:
  bigdata:
    image: franki678/bigdata-sandbox:full
    container_name: bigdata
    environment:
      DATANODES: "2"
      REPLICATION: "2"
      BLOCK_SIZE: "1m"
      NAMENODES: "1"
      SERVICIOS: "todo"
      MONGODB: "no"
      JUPYTER: "si"
      # PIG_HEAPSIZE: "512"
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8080:8080"             # esta interfaz
      - "127.0.0.1:9870:9870"             # NameNode 1
      - "127.0.0.1:9868:9868"             # Secondary NameNode
      - "127.0.0.1:9901-9909:9901-9909"   # DataNode N en 990N
      - "127.0.0.1:8088:8088"             # YARN ResourceManager
      - "127.0.0.1:8042:8042"             # NodeManager
      - "127.0.0.1:19888:19888"           # JobHistory
      - "127.0.0.1:10000:10000"           # HiveServer2 (JDBC)
      - "127.0.0.1:10002:10002"           # HiveServer2 (web)
      - "127.0.0.1:18080:18080"           # Spark History
      - "127.0.0.1:4040:4040"             # trabajo de Spark activo
      - "127.0.0.1:8888:8888"             # JupyterLab
    volumes:
      - bigdata_hadoop:/hadoop              # HDFS, metastore, MySQL y MongoDB
      - ./datos:/datos                      # tu carpeta datos/ adentro
    stop_grace_period: 20s

volumes:
  bigdata_hadoop:
    name: bigdata_hadoop

validate.message: Hay 1 DataNode: cada bloque va a quedar con 1 copia y HDFS lo marca sub-replicado.

    container_name: bigdata

      - "127.0.0.1:8080:8080"             # esta interfaz
      - "127.0.0.1:9870:9870"             # NameNode 1
      - "127.0.0.1:9871-9872:9871-9872"   # NameNodes 2 y 3
      - "127.0.0.1:8480-8482:8480-8482"   # JournalNodes
      - "127.0.0.1:9901-9909:9901-9909"   # DataNode N en 990N
      - "127.0.0.1:8088:8088"             # YARN ResourceManager
      - "127.0.0.1:8042:8042"             # NodeManager
      - "127.0.0.1:19888:19888"           # JobHistory
      - "127.0.0.1:10000:10000"           # HiveServer2 (JDBC)
      - "127.0.0.1:10002:10002"           # HiveServer2 (web)
      - "127.0.0.1:18080:18080"           # Spark History
      - "127.0.0.1:4040:4040"             # trabajo de Spark activo
      - "127.0.0.1:27017:27017"           # MongoDB
      - "127.0.0.1:8888:8888"             # JupyterLab
    volumes:
      - bigdata_hadoop:/hadoop              # HDFS, metastore, MySQL y MongoDB
      - ./datos:/datos                      # tu carpeta datos/ adentro
    stop_grace_period: 20s

volumes:
  bigdata_hadoop:
    name: bigdata_hadoop
